title: US fixed-income markets closed for Columbus Day while the equity tape trades a full session — the Monday of October 2027 expiration week
source:
NEWS: sifma.org/resources/general/holiday-schedule ('Holiday Schedule', SIFMA's own US Holiday Recommendations panel), fetched direct 2026-09-06 (HTTP 200, 298,772 bytes). The 2027 US panel is a hidden tab the rendered page drops, so this session parsed it out of the page's own embedded Next.js payload, exactly as the sifma-bond-early-close-2027-05-28 entry did: the fields read in order 'Labor Day' / 'Monday, September 6, 2027' / 'Columbus Day' / 'Monday, October 11, 2027' / 'Veterans Day' / 'Thursday, November 11, 2027'. NO early-close note attaches to the Columbus Day entry, unlike the July 2027 one three fields earlier ('Early Close (2:00 p.m. Eastern Time): Friday, July 2, 2027') -- so this is a recommended FULL close, and the neighbouring early-close entries are the positive control for the parser. CORROBORATED INDEPENDENTLY BY A SECOND PRIMARY: OCC's own 2027 expiration calendar (www.optionseducation.org/api/expirationcalendar, HTTP 200, 34,855 bytes, fetched the same session) carries the row {"date":"2027-10-11T00:00:00","holiday":{"description":"

Bank holiday

"}} -- a bank holiday marker, not an exchange/OCC holiday marker, which is the same distinction. AND BY ARITHMETIC: Columbus Day is the second Monday of October, and October 2027's second Monday is the 11th. THE EQUITY TAPE IS OPEN: NYSE's own hours-calendars page (HTTP 200, 109,148 bytes, fetched this session) lists no October closure in its 2027 column and no October early close. Filed estimate on the same three counts as every SIFMA entry in this calendar: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has no slot for an industry trade association's recommended schedule, this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, and SIFMA states its closes are recommendations only and subject to change. Discovered during the opex-2027-10-15 initial research, checked 2026-09-06
notes: DISCOVERED during the opex-2027-10-15 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-06). WHY THIS LANE PROPOSES IT AND THE PARENT DID NOT: fomc-blackout-start-2027-10-16's leg 7 read the same SIFMA panel, correctly noted Columbus Day sits five days BEFORE that gate opens, and declined to propose it as outside its corridor. It is inside this one -- 2027-10-11 is the Monday of October 2027 expiration week, four sessions before the 2027-10-15 monthly expiration. ID SHAPE, STATED BECAUSE IT IS NEW: this calendar's existing SIFMA class is sifma-bond-early-close-<date> and every member is a 2:00 p.m. ET early close; a recommended FULL close had no id shape, so this proposal opens sifma-bond-holiday-close-<date>. Kind 'rates' follows the sibling entries -- EventKind has no market-structure member. MEASURED AND REFUSED AS AN EDGE, TWICE. (a) The session type is a null: across the 33 bond-closed / equity-open sessions 2007-2026 (Columbus Day plus weekday Veterans Day), the S&P's mean absolute move is 1.002% against 0.796% for the other 4,917 sessions (permutation P = 0.197) and its median is LOWER (0.424% against 0.524%); the VIX change reads -0.609 against +0.005 (P = 0.077) but its MEDIAN is +0.030, so the mean is carried by a handful of 2008-2011 observations and no claim rests on it. (b) The coincidence is routine, not a 2027 property: Columbus Day falls inside October expiration week in 13 of the 21 years 2007-2027, structurally, because the second Monday and the third Friday share a week whenever October opens late in the week. ESTIMATE WIDENS CAUTION AND LICENSES NOTHING: a recommended fixed-income close is not a market-wide halt, symbols is empty, and no house playbook is calendar- or holiday-keyed (docs/plans/trade-playbooks.md and docs/research/multi-symbol-sweep.md re-grepped this session for 'opex|expiration|witching|SOQ|third friday|pin|blackout|columbus': zero real hits, the four matches all being the substring 'pin' inside gapping/flipping/overlapping/dropping). HONEST LIMIT: whether CME's rate futures keep separate hours that Monday is NOT asserted and was not fetched -- the same gap sifma-bond-early-close-2027-03-25 and -2027-05-28 both left open.
